Supply and Delivery#001.src: Oh, man... What am I going to do now...
Supply and Delivery#001.dst: 唉，天啊……我現在該怎麼辦……
Supply and Delivery#001.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#002.src: O-oh! H-hello soldier! Wow, what a coincidence that we're both here... in {p}... today...
Supply and Delivery#002.dst: 哦、哦！你、你好啊士兵！哇，我們今天居然都在……在 {p}……真巧啊……
Supply and Delivery#002.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#003.src: What? Don't look at me like that! We had a perfectly fair interaction which we both benefitted from. I got the plant, and you... well. You gained experience?
Supply and Delivery#003.dst: 幹嘛？別用那種眼神看我！我們那次交易完全公平，雙方都得利。我拿到了植物，而你……嗯。你得到了經驗？
Supply and Delivery#003.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#004.src: Look, alright, I get it! But I can't pay you back either way. The mayor sent me here to pick up a crate of supplies for the village.
Supply and Delivery#004.dst: 聽著，好啦，我懂！可是我怎麼樣都還不了你錢。鎮長派我來這裡領一箱給村子的補給。
Supply and Delivery#004.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#005.src: The issue is... I've already run out of money on- uh, unrelated purchases. And even if I had the money, I couldn't buy the supply crate anyway...
Supply and Delivery#005.dst: 問題是……我的錢已經花在——呃，別的事情上了。而且就算我有錢，我也買不到那箱補給……
Supply and Delivery#005.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#006.src: Those two over there who run the market banned me from ever using it after I tried to buy out the world's supplies of magical powders.
Supply and Delivery#006.dst: 那邊管市集的那兩個人，在我試圖把全世界的魔法粉末都掃光之後，就永久禁止我使用市集了。
Supply and Delivery#006.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#007.src: Look, it's not my fault I'm making big market moves. I'm just, you know- smarter than all these other folks!
Supply and Delivery#007.dst: 聽著，我在市場上做大動作又不是我的錯。我只是，你知道的——比這裡其他人都聰明！
Supply and Delivery#007.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#008.src: ... The point is. I could really use your help right now! I- I promise, I'll pay you back for it this time.
Supply and Delivery#008.dst: ……總之。我現在真的很需要你幫忙！我——我保證，這次我一定還你。
Supply and Delivery#008.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#009.src: All you need to do is go over to the Trade Market, and buy the supply crate for me. Please?
Supply and Delivery#009.dst: 你只要走到貿易市集，幫我把那箱補給買下來就好。拜託？
Supply and Delivery#009.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#018.src: Well, do you have any other friends we could get involved? There was... that other soldier guy, right? His name was... Tim. Or something.
Supply and Delivery#018.dst: 那，你還有沒有別的朋友可以拉進來？就……那個另外一個當兵的，對吧？他叫……Tim。之類的。

Supply and Delivery#019.src: Look- alright, I get it, I'm a jerk who doesn't remember peoples' names! Could you just ask him to buy the supplies for us?? He's our last hope... probably.
Supply and Delivery#019.dst: 聽著——好啦，我懂，我是個記不住別人名字的混蛋！你能不能就去請他幫我們把補給買下來？他是我們最後的希望……大概吧。
Supply and Delivery#019.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#020.src: Purchase the supply crate from the Trade Market at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Supply and Delivery#020.dst: 到 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的貿易市集買下那箱補給。

Supply and Delivery#021.src: Hey, good work! Now you'll need to pick up the supply crate.
Supply and Delivery#021.dst: 嘿，幹得好！接下來你得去把那箱補給領回來。
Supply and Delivery#021.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#022.src: Find Tasim at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and convince him to buy the supply crate for you.
Supply and Delivery#022.dst: 到 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 找 Tasim，說服他幫你買下那箱補給。

Supply and Delivery#023.src: Oh, hey {u}! Are you just here to hang out? Or- that look on your face tells me you're here for something else.
Supply and Delivery#023.dst: 哦，嘿，{u}！你只是來晃晃的嗎？還是——你臉上那個表情告訴我，你是為了別的事來的。
Supply and Delivery#023.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#076.src: [{~}] Can you buy something from the Trade Market for me?
Supply and Delivery#076.dst: [{~}] 你能不能幫我從貿易市集買個東西？

Supply and Delivery#024.src: I... guess so? Is there a reason you can't do it yourself?
Supply and Delivery#024.dst: 我……應該可以？你自己不能買，是有什麼原因嗎？
Supply and Delivery#024.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#025.src: ...You're banned from the market? How did you even manage that? We haven't even been in {p} for that long!
Supply and Delivery#025.dst: ……你被市集禁止進入？你到底是怎麼辦到的？我們來 {p} 根本沒多久啊！
Supply and Delivery#025.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#026.src: You- what!? Nevermind, I don't actually want to know. Come on, lead the way. I'll buy... whatever it is you need.
Supply and Delivery#026.dst: 你——什麼？！算了，我其實不想知道。走吧，你帶路。不管你要什麼……我幫你買。
Supply and Delivery#026.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#027.src: ...Oh. Well, that explains that. Though- is there a reason you can't get it yourself?
Supply and Delivery#027.dst: ……哦。那就說得通了。不過——你自己不能去拿，是有什麼原因嗎？
Supply and Delivery#027.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#037.src: Bring Tasim to the Trade Market at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Supply and Delivery#037.dst: 帶 Tasim 到 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的貿易市集。

Supply and Delivery#038.src: Alright. So I'm just buying a supply crate...
Supply and Delivery#038.dst: 好。所以我只是要買一箱補給……
Supply and Delivery#038.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#039.src: Here it is. I wish you luck with... whatever it is you're up to.
Supply and Delivery#039.dst: 拿去。不管你在忙什麼……祝你順利。
Supply and Delivery#039.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#040.src: Return to Ope with the supply crate at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Supply and Delivery#041.src: Perfect! Now, quickly, come back over here, before those two realize you're working with me!
Supply and Delivery#041.dst: 太好了！快，趁那兩個人還沒發現你跟我是一夥的，快回這邊來！
Supply and Delivery#041.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#042.src: You got the item? Good. Good, good good.
Supply and Delivery#042.dst: 東西拿到了？好。很好、很好。
Supply and Delivery#042.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#043.src: Okay! Now, we're onto step two. So, you see, this package still needs to make it to {p}...
Supply and Delivery#043.dst: 好！那我們進入第二步。你看，這箱東西還是得送到 {p} 去……
Supply and Delivery#043.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#044.src: And. Well. You're the one holding the crate, not me! So... you know!
Supply and Delivery#044.dst: 而。嗯。拿著箱子的人是你，不是我！所以……你懂的！
Supply and Delivery#044.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#045.src: Great! You know the way by now, surely! No need for me to, uh, get in your way!
Supply and Delivery#045.dst: 太好了！路你現在肯定認得了！用不著我，呃，在旁邊礙事！
Supply and Delivery#045.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#046.src: Just take those supplies to {p}, and. Well. Things will work out.
Supply and Delivery#046.dst: 你就把那些補給送到 {p}，然後。嗯。事情就會順利解決的。
Supply and Delivery#046.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#048.src: Well, you see. I really don't want to do it. And I'm not going to!
Supply and Delivery#048.dst: 你看，是這樣的。我真的很不想做這件事。而我也不打算做！
Supply and Delivery#048.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#049.src: So you either run the supplies to {p}... or we both run away and start new lives, and we avoid the consequences of our actions!
Supply and Delivery#049.dst: 所以你要嘛把補給跑一趟送到 {p}……要嘛我們兩個一起跑路重新做人，把自己的爛攤子甩在後面！
Supply and Delivery#049.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#050.src: ...no? No. Okay. Worth a shot. Well, you know the way by now! No need for me to, uh, get in your way! Heh...
Supply and Delivery#050.dst: ……不要？不要。好吧。試試看嘛。路你現在認得了！用不著我，呃，在旁邊礙事！嘿……
Supply and Delivery#050.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#051.src: He bought you the item? Good. Good, good good. Okay! That was... harder than expected.
Supply and Delivery#051.dst: 他幫你把東西買下來了？好。很好、很好。好！這……比我想的還難。
Supply and Delivery#051.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#060.src: Bring the supply crate to Mayor Alvin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Supply and Delivery#060.dst: 把補給箱送到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 {p}，交給 Alvin 鎮長。

Supply and Delivery#061.src: Ah, hello! What can I do for you today?
Supply and Delivery#061.dst: 啊，你好！今天有什麼我能為你效勞的嗎？
Supply and Delivery#061.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#062.src: Ah... So you do. I thought I had sent Ope to pick that up...
Supply and Delivery#062.dst: 啊……原來如此。我記得我是派 Ope 去領的……
Supply and Delivery#062.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#063.src: More of his shenanigans, I suppose. I am sorry you have had to deal with him twice.
Supply and Delivery#063.dst: 我想又是他那些鬼把戲吧。真抱歉讓你跟他打了兩次交道。
Supply and Delivery#063.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#064.src: When he returns to the village, I'm going to need to have a word with him... Ah, but of course, I should pay you for your troubles.
Supply and Delivery#064.dst: 等他回村裡，我得跟他好好談一談……啊，不過當然了，我該為你的辛勞付你報酬。
Supply and Delivery#064.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#065.src: I hope these emeralds will suffice. Additionally... we recently fixed up one of our broken carts, which makes the trip to {p} and back.
Supply and Delivery#065.dst: 希望這些綠寶石夠。另外……我們最近修好了一輛壞掉的馬車，可以往返 {p}。
Supply and Delivery#065.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#066.src: You may feel free to use it whenever you like! As thanks for all you have done for us.
Supply and Delivery#066.dst: 你隨時想用都可以！算是謝謝你為我們做的一切。
Supply and Delivery#066.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#067.src: He's... difficult. He's the son of my sister, who was unfortunately killed by spiders some time ago.
Supply and Delivery#067.dst: 他……很難搞。他是我姐姐的兒子，而我姐姐不久前不幸被蜘蛛害死了。
Supply and Delivery#067.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#068.src: With his father out of the picture, I had to take him in. He's a grown man now, yes, but... I fear the loss has taken a toll on us both.
Supply and Delivery#068.dst: 他父親也不在了，我只好把他接來養。他現在是個成年人沒錯，可是……我怕那份失去在我們兩個身上都留下了傷。
Supply and Delivery#068.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#069.src: I truly hope he will cease with these ridiculous ploys sometime soon... but I can't bring myself to do more than give him a stern talking to.
Supply and Delivery#069.dst: 我真心希望他能早點停止這些荒唐的把戲……可是我除了板起臉訓他幾句，實在狠不下心做更多。
Supply and Delivery#069.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#070.src: He's a good man, truly. I believe that with my whole heart. It's alright if you don't feel the same way, though. I will not force you to interact with him if you do not wish to.
Supply and Delivery#070.dst: 他是個好人，真的。這一點我打從心底相信。不過你要是不這麼想，那也沒關係。你不願意跟他往來，我不會勉強你。
Supply and Delivery#070.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#071.src: Oh, dear... I suppose it must have been fifteen years ago that I took the position, when the old mayor stepped down.
Supply and Delivery#071.dst: 哎呀……我接下這個位子，應該是十五年前的事了，那時候老鎮長卸任。
Supply and Delivery#071.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#072.src: He was a kind man, always looking out for the townsfolk. Though, by the time he retired, it was clear he was growing restless in our little town.
Supply and Delivery#072.dst: 他是個好心人，總是照顧著鎮上的人。不過他退休的時候，看得出來他在我們這座小鎮已經待不住了。
Supply and Delivery#072.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#073.src: Well, as soon as he passed down the position to me, he immediately traveled to {p} and enlisted in their army! I hear he's in the business of training soldiers these days.
Supply and Delivery#073.dst: 結果呢，他一把位子交給我，立刻就跑去 {p} 從軍了！我聽說他現在在訓練士兵。
Supply and Delivery#073.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#074.src: Ah, but I've tried lived up to his legacy. I like to think I've done well in my time as mayor!
Supply and Delivery#074.dst: 啊，不過我一直努力想不辜負他留下來的東西。我想我這些年的鎮長當得還不錯！
Supply and Delivery#074.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#075.src: A fine day for passing through! I hope you enjoy your stay.
Supply and Delivery#075.dst: 今天真是路過的好日子！希望你在這裡待得愉快。
Supply and Delivery#075.speaker: Mayor Alvin
